chose: A spoken hunch is heard as a voice note of a new kind, hunch, with its ref set to the hunch's name: PUT /voice-notes/:id?of=hunch&ref=<hunch>, then POST /voice-notes/:id/fast-track, then poll GET /voice-notes/:id/heard. It is heard in English with no prompt, and no new route is added. The kept hunch finds its take through the ref.
options: a voice note of kind hunch, heard by the transcriber
a new route that hears the take on the request's path
gray: A hearing waits on the transcriber's poll (up to a minute) plus the hearing itself; fast-track only skips a give. The port's hear(take) has to carry the hunch's name. It costs a voice_note CHECK rebuild while S14 (#512) is open.
